- REALISTIC ARTIFICIAL GREENERY: Create a fresh, natural look with a realistic artificial hanging basket featuring 34 lifelike PE leaves. Enjoy year-round greenery without watering, trimming or ongoing maintenance.

- READY TO HANG: Supplied fully assembled with a durable hanging basket and sturdy metal wire support, so you can decorate your garden, balcony or home straight from the box.

## Information
Bring lasting greenery to any space with this Artificial Hanging Basket. Featuring 34 realistic PE leaves, it provides the appearance of healthy foliage without the need for watering, pruning or maintenance. Constructed from durable UV-resistant materials, this faux hanging basket is designed for both indoor and outdoor use, helping maintain its vibrant appearance even when displayed in sunny locations. Lightweight and supplied fully assembled, it's ready to hang in minutes and is ideal for balconies, patios, porches, conservatories, living rooms and bedrooms. Whether you're brightening a garden wall or adding a touch of greenery indoors, this maintenance-free hanging basket offers year-round decorative appeal.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- REALISTIC FERN DESIGN: Add instant greenery to your home with a beautifully crafted artificial fern wreath featuring lush leaves and a natural-looking appearance.
- VERSATILE HOME DECOR: Perfect as a front door wreath, wall decoration, porch accessory, window display or indoor feature, bringing a fresh botanical look to any space.
- YEAR-ROUND FOLIAGE: Enjoy the look of vibrant foliage throughout every season without watering, pruning or regular maintenance. A simple way to refresh your décor.
- INDOOR & OUTDOOR DECORATION: Ideal for decorating front doors, porches, hallways, living rooms, conservatories, garden rooms and other spaces around your home.
- PERFECT FOR EVERY OCCASION: Use as everyday home décor or dress up your entrance for parties, gatherings, weddings, birthdays and seasonal celebrations.
- EASY DECORATIVE UPDATE: Lightweight and easy to display, this faux greenery wreath creates an inviting entrance and adds a touch of natural style without the upkeep of real plants.

## Information
Bring a fresh botanical feel to your home with this beautiful Artificial Greenery Wreath, designed with realistic-looking faux fern leaves and lush foliage. Perfect for adding colour, texture and natural-inspired style to your front door, porch, wall or indoor space. This artificial fern wreath is a versatile decoration that can be enjoyed all year round. Unlike real foliage, it requires no watering, trimming or specialist care, making it an easy way to keep your home looking fresh and inviting. Simply display it on your front door, wall, window or anywhere that needs a decorative touch of greenery. Ideal for both everyday home decoration and special occasions, this faux greenery wreath can be used to create a welcoming entrance for guests or complement your existing décor. It is suitable for front doors, porches, hallways, living rooms, conservatories, garden rooms, weddings, parties and celebrations. The timeless fern design makes this wreath easy to style with a wide range of interiors and exterior décor. Use it on its own for a simple natural look or pair it with ribbons, flowers, lights and other decorations to create your own personalised display. A stylish and practical alternative to fresh foliage, this artificial fern wreath is a simple way to bring the beauty of greenery into your home without the ongoing maintenance of real plants.

## Features
- Beautiful natural white ceramic jug with a distinctive petal-shaped design
- Gently ribbed body adds depth and handcrafted character
- Scalloped rim and curved handle create an elegant artisan finish
- Ideal for fresh or dried flowers, table displays or shelf styling
- A versatile accent suited to farmhouse, country and contemporary interiors
- Made from ceramic for a durable decorative display piece.

## Information
Add a touch of rustic elegance to your home with this beautifully crafted ceramic jug featuring a charming petal-shaped design. Finished in a soft natural white glaze, this jug exudes a timeless, country-cottage aesthetic that complements a wide variety of interior styles, from farmhouse to contemporary. The graceful ribbed texture running along the body adds depth and visual interest, whilst the scalloped rim and classic curved handle lend it a refined, artisanal quality. This generously sized jug is as practical as it is decorative. Use it as a striking centrepiece filled with fresh or dried flowers, as a stylish vessel on a dining table, or simply display it on a shelf or windowsill to enhance your living space. The smooth, glazed ceramic finish gives it a polished look whilst remaining sturdy and durable for everyday use. Whether gifted to a loved one or kept for yourself, this elegant ceramic jug is a versatile and charming addition to any home.

## Features
- A premium 125 cm artificial olive tree with pot, designed with lifelike details for an elegant, low-maintenance display.
- Wired stems allow the branches to be adjusted easily, while multiple real wood stems and silk leaves create a natural-looking shape.
- Detailed with highly realistic decorative olives. Keep away from young children, as the olives may look edible.
- The approximately 18 cm wide by 15 cm high pot can be placed inside a larger planter and covered with bark, gravel or soil for a more natural display.
- Botanik product, model BK-7384.
- Overall height, 125 cm - overall width and depth, 60 cm.
- Pot size, approximately 18 cm wide by 15 cm high.
- Plastic pot, silk leaves and real wood stems.
- Shipping weight, 1.2 kg.
- Lead time to ship, 1 day.

## Information
Bring natural-looking greenery into your home with this 120cm Botanik artificial olive tree. The tree measures approximately 120cm high, 40cm wide and 30cm deep when arranged as shown, with wired stems that can be shaped to suit your space. Highly realistic olives add an attractive finishing detail, while the moss-covered weighted plastic pot allows the tree to be displayed immediately or placed inside a decorative planter. For a more realistic presentation, position it in a larger planter and cover the pot with bark, gravel or soil. The plastic pot measures approximately 16cm in diameter and 13cm high. Any metal planters shown in product images are for display purposes only and are not included. Exercise caution around small children, as the olives may appear edible.
Artificial Olive Tree with pot, a luxurious addition to our premium collection of artificial plants and trees. Crafted to perfection, these pieces are so lifelike that they are nearly impossible to tell apart from real plants, making them a stunning choice for any space. With wired stems for easy customization to suit your specific area. Featuring multiple real wood stems and silk leaves, this masterpiece even includes highly realistic olives (please be mindful around young children, as they may mistake them for real fruit). Arriving fully potted in a moss-covered weighted plastic pot approximately, this elegant tree can be left as is or placed inside a decorative planter for added charm. For an even more striking appearance, consider placing it inside a larger planter and covering it with bark, gravel, or soil to enhance its lifelike allure.

## Information
Add year-round greenery to a hallway, office or conservatory with this realistic 140 cm artificial Japanese Fruticosa tree. It features a natural wood trunk and botanically accurate foliage, with wired leaf stems that can be arranged to suit your space. Each tree is handcrafted, so minor variations may occur. The tree arrives ready to display in a plain black plastic pot measuring 18 cm in diameter and 15 cm high. For a decorative finish, place it inside a larger planter of your choice. The decorative planter shown is not included.
This plant and metal planter bundle is a luxurious addition to any space. The Artificial Ruscus tree is meticulously crafted with a natural trunk and realistic leaf arrangements, making it perfect for hallways, office buildings, and conservatories. The main trunk is made of real natural wood, and the leaf stems are wired for easy arrangement to fit your space perfectly. This premium artificial tree is highly realistic with botanically accurate foliage, and each one is unique due to the handcrafted nature of the product. The metal planter, included in the bundle, and is made of metal with a brushed brass finish, adding a touch of elegance to the overall look. This bundle offers a big saving on buying the items separately, and the two items are separate, allowing you to swap the plant over or use the planter for something else if desired.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Size: One Size
- Composition: 100% Plastic
- Product Type: Artificial Flower

## Information
Bring the untamed beauty of wildflowers into your space with this botanically accurate stem that perfectly mimics the delicate charm of garden-fresh cow parsley. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Each flower has 45 overlapping faux silk petals.
- The purple flowers have hints of blue and white.
- The flowers are prettily marked in the middle.
- All the faux silk pansies have a yellow stamen.
- The leaves are scalloped made from faux silk.
- Moss covers the base of the plant
- The terrracotta colour pots are made from plastic.
- Each pansy is made from faux silk material.

## Information
Plastic patio planters with bright and vibrant artificial pansies and decorative conifer/cedar topiary in the centre. Extremely realistic and life-like looking. Hard to tell they are not real from only a short distance. Pot size width 24cm, height 21cm. The overall height including the plants is approximately 60cm. Ready assembled and ready to display straightaway on your porch, patio, or garden. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use (UV protected to prevent colour fading). They can stay outside in all weather conditions all year round. However, we do advise keeping them out of extremely windy areas as strong winds May blow them over. Easy and carefree alternative to real plants and flowers. No care or attention required. No time-consuming watering, or pruning anymore, simply unpack, position, sit back and enjoy. They look fantastic pretty much anywhere in the garden or around the house but also great outside shop fronts, bars, restaurants, and hotels as well as offices, schools, and nurseries. Available with different colours: purple & yellow, soft pink & white or pink & white flowers. Please note, matching hanging baskets, rattan patio planters and window boxes are also available. The planters are packed in cardboard boxes for protection during shipment, this may cause the foliage to be a little compressed or out of shape on arrival. We recommend you spend a little time when you open the box to gently arranging the foliage by folding out branches, leaves and flower to a natural looking shape.

## Features
- Each flower has 45 overlapping faux silk petals.
- The purple flowers have hints of blue and white.
- The flowers are prettily marked in the middle.
- All the faux silk pansies have a yellow stamen.
- The leaves are scalloped made from faux silk.
- Moss covers the base of the plant
- The baskets are made from real willow rattan.
- Each pansy is made from faux silk material.

## Information
Pair of rattan patio planters/baskets with bright and vibrant artificial pansies and decorative conifer/cedar topiary in the centre. Extremely realistic and life-like looking. Hard to tell they are not real from only a short distance. Dark rattan planters/baskets, size 24 x 24cm at the top and 60cm in height. Ready assembled and ready to display straightaway on your porch, patio or garden. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use (UV protected to prevent colour fading). Can stay outside in all weather conditions all year round. However, we do advise keeping them out of extremely windy areas as strong winds may blow them over. Easy and carefree alternative to real plants and flowers. No care or attention required. No time-consuming watering, feeding or pruning anymore, simply unpack, position, sit back and enjoy. They look fantastic pretty much anywhere in the garden or around the house but also great outside shop fronts, bars, restaurants and hotels as well as offices, schools and nurseries. Available with different colours: all white, white & yellow, purple & yellow, purple & white or pink & white flowers. The planters are packed in cardboard boxes for protection during shipment, this may cause the foliage to be a little compressed or out of shape on arrival. We recommend you spend a little time when you open the box to gently arranging the foliage by folding out branches, leaves and flower to a natural looking shape. To view our range of artificial products on please type \"Greenbrokers\" in the search bar. About us: We design and supply an exclusive range of top-quality artificial trees and flowers which have been made to our exact specifications to look as life-like as possible. We pride ourselves in the quality of our products and excellent customer service.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Premium quality, exceptionally lifelike and realistic.
- UV protected, suitable for both indoor & outdoor use.
- Sold as a pair (set of 2). Height: 90cm/3ft.
- Look stunning planted up into large tubs placed either side of front doors or entrances.

## Information
These classically shaped artificial boxwood spiral trees are extremely lifelike and realistic looking. From a short distance it's hard to believe they are not real. Perfect if you don't want the hassle or have the time to care for living plants. Easy and maintenance free so no need to water or prune. The trees simply look perfect all year round. Suitable for outdoor use, the foliage is UV protected to prevent the colour from fading. The trees look absolutely fantastic either side of entrances, doorways, on the balcony, outside shop fronts, offices and receptions as well as bars & restaurants. For an extra stylish look, plant the trees up into large planters or tubs. Fill the bottom with a heavy material such as sand or stones to prevent the tree from being blown over in strong winds. Then fill with a material that can be compacted such as ordinary soil up to the level you want the tree to sit in the planter. Place the tree in the middle and fill to the top and compact hard around the plastic pot and the base of the tree. The tree has a strong solid wood centre, making it robust and durable. They are supplied in a plastic pot with concrete filling to stabilize the base of the tree. Please note the trees are packed in cardboard cartons for maximum protection. The trees are lying down flat in the boxes which can cause the plastic foliage to be compressed and a little out of shape. The perfect shape can be regained by gently pulling and fluffing the foliage back into shape. These trees are sold as a pair (2 trees per carton).

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Premium quality, exceptionally lifelike and realistic.
- UV protected, suitable for both indoor & outdoor use.
- Sold as a pair (set of 2). Height: 90cm/3ft.
- Look stunning planted up into large tubs placed either side of front doors or entrances.
- Maintenance free

## Information
A pair of premium quality, highly desirable artificial spiral boxwood topiary trees measuring 90cm/3ft in height. Extremely lifelike and realistic looking, from a short distance it's hard to believe they are not real. Easy and carefree alternative to real plants. Perfect if you don't want the hassle or have the time to care for living plants. They look absolutely fantastic either side of doorways, on the balcony or patio. Also outside shop fronts, offices and receptions as well as bars & restaurants. For an extra stylish look, plant the trees up into large planters or tubs. Fill the bottom with a heavy material such as sand or stones to prevent the tree being blown over in strong winds. Then fill with a material that can be compacted such as ordinary soil up to the level you want the tree to sit in the planter. Place the tree in the middle and fill to the top and compact hard around the plastic pot and the base of the tree. The core is a metal pole which the plastic foliage spirals around. The metal core is not visible as the foliage is thick and covers the pole entirely. The metal core provides a strong solid centre for the tree, making it robust and durable. Supplied in a black plastic pot with concrete filling to stabilize the base of the tree. The pot can be removed simply by pulling out the metal centre from its housing in the pot. Please note the trees are packed in cardboard cartons for maximum protection. The trees are lying down flat in the boxes which can cause the plastic foliage to be compressed and out of shape. The perfect shape can be regained by gently pulling and fluffing the foliage back into shape. Sold as a pair (2 trees per carton).

## Information
Limburg XL: This tall and impressive Delft-inspired floor vase brings classic blue-and-white charm to your home. Made from durable porcelain, it features a beautiful decorations and pattern of birds and flowers, inspired by traditional Dutch Delft Blue artwork. Its elegant, rounded shape and narrow neck make it ideal for displaying long-stemmed flowers or standing alone as a statement piece. The soft blue details add a calm, timeless look that fits easily into both modern and traditional spaces. Features: Material: High-quality ceramic, Porcelain Colour: Cobalt blue and white, glazed. Design: Decorated with birds and floral motifs Dimensions: 63x27x27cm Tall, graceful shape – perfect for long flowers or greenery, A stylish addition to living rooms, entryways, or dining spaces Delft blue vase, blue and white porcelain vase, bird design vase, Dutch style decor, tall ceramic vase, classic home decoration, floral porcelain vase, blue and white pottery, Delft-inspired home accents. DUTCH BLAUW COLLECTION Our Dutch Blauw (blue) collection draws its inspiration from the rich heritage of Delft Blue ceramics, a true symbol of Dutch artistry and tradition. Each piece captures the essence of the iconic blue-and-white patterns that have adorned Dutch pottery for centuries, often with flowers, birds or exotic Asian patterns. Blending historical craftsmanship with a modern design approach, Dutch Blauw transforms timeless motifs into elegant, contemporary creations. From delicate floral details to refined geometric designs, every item in the collection reflects the beauty and authenticity of classic Delft Blue while fitting seamlessly into today’s interiors. Celebrate Dutch heritage and modern sophistication with the Dutch Blauw collection—where tradition meets innovation in perfect harmony. DELFTS BLUE INSPIRATION Delft Blue ceramics (also known as Delfts Blauw in Dutch) are a traditional form of pottery that originated in the city of Delft, the Netherlands, during the 17th century. These ceramics are instantly recognisable by their distinctive blue-and-white hand-painted designs, typically depicting floral motifs, pastoral scenes, windmills, and intricate patterns. Inspired by the imported Chinese porcelain that was highly sought after in Europe at the time, Delft Blue developed as a local interpretation of this luxurious style — making it a beautiful example of Chinoiserie, a European artistic trend that reflected fascination with East Asian art and design. Today, Delft Blue ceramics are treasured for their classic craftsmanship, timeless beauty, and cultural heritage. They remain a popular choice for collectors and home decor enthusiasts alike, bringing a touch of historic charm and refined elegance to any setting. Dare to be distinctive! ## Features
- Flexible and structured design
- Made from polyethylene
- Quick and easy installation
- Suitable for indoor or outdoor use
- Low-Maintenance greenery

## Information
Step into a space transformed by effortless elegance where lush textures and contemporary design come together to create a striking visual impact. Whether it is an inviting indoor feature wall or a refreshing outdoor retreat, these artificial wall tiles brings your vision to life with its seamless blend of practicality and sophistication. Crafted from 100% polyethylene these artificial wall tile are built for lasting beauty and functionality. Its weather and UV resistant properties ensure it stands up to the elements making it equally suitable for indoor and outdoor use. The innovative PE back grid adds to its versatility allowing the tiles to be resized, revised, or reused to suit your creative vision. This adaptability makes them a perfect choice for any project whether you are covering a large area or adding a unique accent to a smaller space. Installation is designed with simplicity in mind. The tiles feature a snap and lock mechanism allowing for quick and seamless assembly that results in a flawless finish. With the included fixing kit you can easily screw them directly to walls or fences or use tie wraps to secure them to a frame for added flexibility. No matter your approach these tiles make it easy to achieve a polished professional look with minimal effort. In addition to their striking design and practicality the tiles are wonderfully low maintenance. A quick clean or occasional dusting is all it takes to keep them looking fresh and vibrant. Whether you are creating a tranquil garden backdrop revitalising a tired fence or adding a modern touch indoors their enduring quality and striking design provide an effortless way to enhance your living spaces.
Measuring 50cm x 100cm, these tiles offer expansive coverage, allowing you to effortlessly create the look of a realistic plant wall. Designed for both impact and practicality, their structured yet flexible form ensures a seamless fit, whether you're enhancing a small feature area or covering an entire surface with vibrant greenery.

## Features
- Novelty hardback book-shaped ceramic vase
- Inscribed with 'Love locked in words' typography
- Heart padlock, bow, and open book motifs
- Detailed spine lettering and page ridges
- Perfect for fresh flowers, dried posies, or pens

## Information
Add a romantic, literary flourish to your shelf, desk, or bedside table with this charming pastel pink book-shaped ceramic vase. Designed to mimic a vintage hardback novel, the front cover features the scripted inscription Love locked in words set between an ornate heart-shaped padlock tied with a bow and an open book radiating starlight. Detailed with delicate book-spine page markings and romantic script on the side, the hollow top opening provides the perfect vessel for fresh spring blooms, dried floral arrangements, or even desk stationery. A sweet, coquette-inspired statement piece and a thoughtful gift for book lovers and hopeless romantics alike.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Create a tropical feel in your home with detailed artificial palm foliage that adds greenery without watering or maintenance.
- Realistic green fronds create an attractive artificial plant display. The tree stands 50cm high when arranged as shown.
- Wired stems can be arranged to suit your space. The pot measures 11cm wide x 9cm high and has fixed, non-shedding imitation soil.
- Supplied in a plain black plastic pot with fixed imitation soil, ready to display or place inside a larger planter.
- Leaf Design UK product.
- Colour: Palm, green.
- Material: plastic.
- Pot size: 11cm wide x 9cm high.
- Weight: 1.23kg.
- Pack size: 1.

## Information
Add a tropical touch to your conservatory, bathroom, hallway or living space with this 50cm artificial palm tree. Its realistic leaf structure and green fronds bring lasting greenery without watering or regular maintenance. The wired stems can be shaped to suit your display, while the compact design makes it easy to position in smaller spaces. It comes ready to display in a plain black plastic pot measuring 11cm wide x 9cm high, topped with fixed imitation soil that will not shed. The metal planter shown in the images is for illustration only and is not included.
Our artificial palm trees have incredible attention to detail and will certainly make your home feel more tropical. These look brilliant in conservatories, bathrooms or hallways and add a splash of greenery with no need to water or maintain them. With a realistic leaf structure and beautiful green fronds this is a really attractive artificial plant. This artificial tree stands high when arranged as shown in the pictures. Stems are wired so this can be arranged to fit your space perfectly. Black plastic pot and has an imitation soil on the top of the pot (fixed and solid, will not shed). It is highly realistic with botanically accurate foliage. It comes potted in a plain plastic pot and is ready to display. You can easily put this inside a larger planter if you wish. The metal planter pictured is for illustration only and is not included.
